races.name: Sandygate Inn, Kingsteignton 'National Hunt' Maiden Hurdle (GBB Race)

runners_data.name: Our Guide
runners_data.note: Hold-up specialist with bumper-winning class who needs a strong pace to aim at but has Sheehan's tactical nous in his favour
runners_data.comment: Promising hurdling debut fifth at Wetherby last month; a big player for leading yard here
runners_data.spotlight: Bought for £82,000 after landing Galway bumper on his debut last October; 2-1, made a promising start over hurdles when fifth of 15 in 2m Wetherby novice last month, nearest finish; capable of better for leading yard and a big player.

runners_data.name: Granpa Ger
runners_data.note: Longstanding maiden but consistent hold-up performer who has shown best form at similar trips and returns refreshed after 144-day break
runners_data.comment: Is 0-21 but a solid fifth in 2m Ludlow novice in November; no forlorn hope after a break
runners_data.spotlight: Longstanding maiden but in good nick for his new stable, fifth of 13 in 2m Ludlow novice in November; no forlorn hope after a break.

runners_data.name: October Hill
runners_data.note: Front-running type who can exploit the lack of pace pressure but remains winless under rules despite consistent placing efforts
runners_data.comment: Is 0-10 under rules but a creditable second at Ludlow latest; she holds good form claims
runners_data.spotlight: Is 0-10 under rules; tongue tied when a creditable second of 12 in 2m Ludlow novice last month; cheekpieces are added now and she holds good form claims.

runners_data.name: Oscar Jack
runners_data.note: Lightly-raced newcomer to hurdling whose bumper debut was poor, making this a fact-finding mission with cheekpieces applied immediately
runners_data.comment: Last in bumper at Wincanton on his debut last month; cheekpieces added for hurdles debut
runners_data.spotlight: 250-1, last of 12 in bumper at Wincanton on his debut last month; cheekpieces are quickly reached for on his first go over hurdles.

runners_data.name: Getone
runners_data.note: Recent course experience but limited ability, relying on hood and tongue-tie to spark improvement from his moderate recent third here
runners_data.comment: Remote third in 2m2f novice here for his new yard recently; lots more is required
runners_data.spotlight: Lightly raced 7yo; hooded and tongue tied when a remote third of eight in 2m2f novice here for his new yard recently; lots more is required.

races.paceDynamic: October Hill will make the early running as the only confirmed front-runner, with no other pace angles likely to challenge her early. This sets up a comfortable, uncontested lead through steady fractions over the 2m½f trip on good ground. The lack of pace pressure means October Hill can dictate terms and potentially steal a march, while the hold-up horses Our Guide, Granpa Ger and Getone will need the pace to collapse late. This race shape clearly favours the prominent runner who can control the tempo from the front.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: October Hill Controls
scenarios.trigger: If October Hill gets an uncontested lead and maintains her jumping rhythm
scenarios.body: She can dictate comfortable fractions and kick clear approaching the last, with her recent Ludlow second form giving her a fitness edge over returning rivals. The addition of cheekpieces should sharpen her focus in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Surge Prevails
scenarios.trigger: If Our Guide's class tells in a slowly-run race that becomes a sprint finish
scenarios.body: The Galway bumper winner's high-end ability comes to the fore when the pace collapses, allowing Gavin Sheehan to time his challenge perfectly from off the pace. October Hill's lack of a win under rules becomes telling when pressured.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Granpa Ger Revival
scenarios.trigger: If Granpa Ger benefits from the long break and produces his best Ludlow form
scenarios.body: The eight-year-old's solid recent efforts for his new stable suggest he's in good order, and the undemanding pace allows him to stay in touch before outstaying rivals up the hill. His experience in these conditions gives him an edge over less-exposed rivals.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Shock Maiden Win
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to handle the occasion and pace collapses completely
scenarios.body: Getone or Oscar Jack capitalize on a tactical mess where the lack of early pace backfires, with the outsiders staying on strongly when others fade. The recent Exeter experience gives Getone a venue advantage despite his modest profile.

watchPoints.text: October Hill's jumping under pressure - any mistake when challenged could end her chance of exploiting the pace advantage
Our Guide's jumping debut over hurdles - his class is evident but hurdling technique remains unproven at this level
Granpa Ger's fitness after 144 days off - any signs of rustiness early could compromise his hold-up tactics
The pace through the first mile - if it goes too slow even October Hill may not have enough in reserve to hold off late challengers
Oscar Jack's adaptation to hurdles after poor bumper form - any early jumping errors would effectively end his involvement

runners_data.name: Stone Cold

runners_data.spotlight: Unplaced in six starts but not disgraced in either of his last two, both over 2m; pedigree suggests that this step up in trip should be a positive, while 4lb drop won't harm; could see a more competitive effort.

runners_data.name: Stinginhisstep

runners_data.comment: Two-time winner over a similar trip (good); should be involved if ready after a break.
runners_data.spotlight: Two-time winner over a similar trip at Newton Abbot (both good); was competitive from this mark on his last two starts at that track (both 2m5f) and should be involved if straight enough after a six-month break.

runners_data.name: Anothermanicmonday
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse but huge outsider for good reason given poor hurdles record
runners_data.comment: Huge odds and well beaten in all three qualifying starts over hurdles; watching brief.
runners_data.spotlight: Huge odds and well beaten in all three qualifying starts over hurdles; watching brief advised.

runners_data.name: Mrs Pen
runners_data.note: Hold-up mare making handicap debut but outclassed on all evidence to date
runners_data.comment: Well beaten all three starts; much more needed even from this mark on handicap debut.
runners_data.spotlight: Triple-figure odds and well beaten in all three qualifying starts; much more needed even from this lowly mark on her handicap debut.

races.paceDynamic: Imperial Jade and Rangatira Jack will ensure a genuine gallop from the start, with This Sway likely to track them prominently early. The pace should be honest rather than frantic over this stamina-testing trip, but neither leader has been in great form recently which could create tactical complications. Green Sky, Taritino and the hold-up horses will get their chance to close from off the pace. This race shape favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed who can position themselves in the first half of the field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Genuine pace holds up
scenarios.trigger: If Imperial Jade and Rangatira Jack maintain a solid gallop to halfway
scenarios.body: The leaders will tire in the testing Exeter finish, but the honest pace will suit those who raced prominently throughout. Green Sky and This Sway can capitalize on their forward positions while having more in reserve.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front runners collapse early
scenarios.trigger: If both Imperial Jade and Rangatira Jack fade before the home turn
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint from the final hurdle with hold-up horses getting first run. Taritino's flat speed and Mr Jukebox's stamina reserves become decisive factors.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical battle develops
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes steady with multiple horses tracking the leaders
scenarios.body: This Sway can use his front-running ability to kick clear, while Green Sky's prominent style keeps him perfectly positioned. The race becomes about who has the most tactical speed.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Messy scramble finish
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely with no clear tempo
scenarios.body: The race becomes a lottery with any horse capable of picking up the pieces from any position. Form and ability matter less than luck in running.

This Sway's 5lb claimer Tom Broughton needs to judge the pace correctly as the horse won making all last time
Rangatira Jack's jumping over hurdles after focusing on chasing - any mistakes could end his chances early
Asian Spice has a strong course record but hasn't shown her best form for months
The ground conditions remain consistent across the card which should help those who handle good going

races.paceDynamic: Watchoutitscookie will be the main pace-setter with Moonlight Artist likely to track him in second, creating a sustainable tempo over this extended 2m7f trip. The bulk of the field including Square Du Roule, Teorie, Man Oh Man, Vengeance, Stage Show and Elfride are confirmed hold-up performers who will be content to settle towards the rear early. With just two prominent runners and six hold-up horses, this creates a very slow early gallop that will build gradually before a late cavalry charge. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners and those hold-up horses with proven stamina who can quicken late over this demanding distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustainable Pace Benefits
scenarios.trigger: If Watchoutitscookie sets a steady tempo without pressure from the field
scenarios.body: The genuine pace allows prominent runners to conserve energy for a strong finish, while the extended distance tests the stamina reserves of hold-up horses making late moves. Square Du Roule's C&D winning form and Watchoutitscookie's front-running ability become decisive advantages.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Late Charge Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace becomes very pedestrian with most runners bunched up turning in
scenarios.body: The slow tempo allows the best of the hold-up horses with proven class to unleash devastating late kicks despite the distance. Stage Show's C&D winning experience and Teorie's previous quality become the differentiating factors in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Front Runner Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Watchoutitscookie faces no early pressure and gets an uncontested lead throughout
scenarios.body: The lack of early pace pressure allows the leader to dictate terms completely before finding extra gear in the straight. Moonlight Artist benefits from the perfect tracking position while others struggle to make up ground from too far back.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Stamina Test Emerges
scenarios.trigger: If the genuine pace combined with the extended distance becomes a true test of staying power
scenarios.body: The 2m7f trip stretches several runners beyond their optimal distance, creating opportunities for those with proven stamina credentials. Man Oh Man's each-way chance improves significantly if he handles the trip extension from his usual shorter distances.

Square Du Roule's 15lb weight rise since C&D win makes his task significantly harder despite improved latest form
Teorie's claimer Robbie David takes off 5lb which brings him closer to his last winning mark
Man Oh Man's stamina for 2m7f remains unproven with his best efforts coming over shorter distances
Stage Show drops back to C&D after poor effort over shorter trip but Isabelle Ryder's 5lb claim helps his cause

races.paceDynamic: Thank You Blue and Amatchmadeinheaven will battle for early supremacy, with both confirmed front-runners likely to set a genuine gallop from the flag. Thank You Blue brings proven stamina over this trip while Amatchmadeinheaven showed his liking for leading when winning here in March. The sustained pace battle between these two will stretch the field and create a demanding test of stamina. This honest gallop strongly favours the hold-up horses who can finish with one run, particularly those proven over the extended distance.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Benefit
scenarios.trigger: If Thank You Blue and Amatchmadeinheaven engage in a prolonged pace duel from early stages.
scenarios.body: The genuine gallop will find out the front-runners late and set up perfectly for closers with stamina reserves. Got A Dream and Blue In The West can use their hold-up styles to maximum effect.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Survives
scenarios.trigger: If one pace-setter gets first run on the other and establishes a controlling lead.
scenarios.body: Thank You Blue's proven stamina gives him the edge to dominate from the front if he can shake off Amatchmadeinheaven early. His hat-trick at Ludlow showed his ability to dictate and stay.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Tactical Surprise
scenarios.trigger: If both main pace-setters are restrained early creating a stop-start pattern.
scenarios.body: A falsely-run race would completely change the complexion and favour horses with tactical speed rather than pure stamina. Mammies Boy could benefit from his trainer Nick Scholfield's 2/9 recent record.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Impact
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace battle completely drains both Thank You Blue and Amatchmadeinheaven.
scenarios.body: The two front-runners fade dramatically in the final half-mile leaving a sprint finish between the hold-up horses. Jack Sprat's class could tell despite his inconsistent recent form under these circumstances.

races.paceDynamic: Mythe Bridge will set a controlled pace from the front with minimal pressure, as the only confirmed front-runner in this 17-runner field. Kit's Coty, Daring Plan and several other prominent racers will track close behind but won't force the issue early over this stamina-testing 3m trip. The sustainable gallop will leave plenty in reserve for the business end, with the race likely to develop into a sprint finish from the final half-mile. This moderate early pace strongly favours hold-up horses who can produce late kicks, as front-runners and prominent racers will be vulnerable to being swamped in the closing stages.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Late Kick Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If the early pace remains steady and reserves are preserved
scenarios.body: The hold-up horses will have too much firepower for the early leaders when the race develops into a sprint. Patient jockeys on the right horses will time their runs to perfection.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Powers Home
scenarios.trigger: If Mythe Bridge or Kit's Coty can dictate without serious pressure
scenarios.body: The early positioning pays dividends as they maintain enough energy to resist late challenges. Their tactical advantage of racing on the pace proves decisive.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If several prominent runners converge on Mythe Bridge before halfway
scenarios.body: The race becomes a test of stamina rather than speed, suiting horses with proven staying power. Those who settle best in the early chaos will emerge strongest.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Front Runner Steals It
scenarios.trigger: If Mythe Bridge gets completely uncontested lead and builds big advantage
scenarios.body: The lack of early pressure allows the leader to control the race from start to finish. By the time others respond, the gap has become unbridgeable.

runners_data.comment: Well below par on handicap debut latest; since had wind surgery; may get competitive.
runners_data.spotlight: Unplaced in five starts; best effort came over C&D (good) last November; well below that level on his handicap debut latest; has since had wind surgery and drops 4lb; may be able to get competitive.

runners_data.name: Prized Jet
runners_data.note: Front-runner who has declined since joining current trainer, first-time tongue-tie applied for this handicap debut
runners_data.comment: 5lb drop sees her on a handy mark and no surprise if she can take advantage.
runners_data.spotlight: Placed in a 3m hurdle (good) when trained in Ireland; has gone backwards in three starts for her current trainer, both in terms of performance and trip; latest 5lb drop sees her on a handy mark and no surprise if she can take advantage.

runners_data.name: Modern Style
runners_data.note: Hold-up horse making handicap debut off low mark, but has shown little ability in either code so far
runners_data.comment: Lowly mark for this handicap debut but only support would pique interest at this stage.
runners_data.spotlight: Frankel gelding who has failed to show much in either code so far; is on a lowly mark for this handicap debut but only market support would pique interest at this stage.

runners_data.name: Prairie Queen
runners_data.note: Front-runner with consistent placing record, handles good ground well and drops in class from recent competitive efforts
runners_data.comment: Has been competitive from this mark on her last three starts and should be again.
runners_data.spotlight: 0-19 but placed over both hurdles and fences at up to 2m4f (all on a sound surface); has been competitive from this mark on her last three starts and should be again.

races.paceDynamic: Prized Jet and Prairie Queen are confirmed pace-setters who will contest the early lead, creating an honest gallop from the start. The presence of two front-runners ensures sustained pace through the first mile, with neither likely to yield easily. This strong early tempo will stretch the field and create opportunities for those positioned prominently rather than held up. The sustained pace favours prominent racers and those with tactical speed over hold-up horses who rely on a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Sustained Pace Battle
scenarios.trigger: If Prized Jet and Prairie Queen engage in a prolonged speed duel through halfway
scenarios.body: The honest gallop plays to prominent runners who can track the pace without getting embroiled in the early battle. Monsun Climate and those positioned just behind the leaders benefit from the strong pace without the energy expenditure.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: One Pacemaker Dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Prairie Queen or Prized Jet establishes an uncontested lead while the other fades early
scenarios.body: The surviving front-runner controls the race tempo and gets an easier lead, making them vulnerable to late challengers with finishing kick. Hold-up horses get their ideal scenario with a more tactical finish.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Scenario
scenarios.trigger: If both Prized Jet and Prairie Queen fade after their early battle, leaving no clear leader
scenarios.body: The race becomes messy with no true pace, suiting horses that can quicken from any position. Those with tactical versatility and recent form have the edge in a sprint finish.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Early Pace Then Steady
scenarios.trigger: If the front-runners settle into a reasonable rhythm after initial positioning
scenarios.body: The race develops into a more traditional staying test where stamina and class prevail. Horses with proven form at the distance and those who stay strongly benefit most.

runners_data.name: Danza Kuduro
runners_data.comment: A half-brother to five winners; this Jet Away newcomer needs considering
runners_data.spotlight: 7,500euros 3yo; half-brother to five winners, including Star Walking (bumper and 2m5f/3m hurdle) and Uptown Harry (2m4f-3m hurdle/chase); dam unraced; this Jet Away newcomer needs considering.

runners_data.name: La Bamba Chica
runners_data.comment: Mount Nelson mare; the market can guide for this debutante
runners_data.spotlight: Mount Nelson mare; half-sister to useful winners Quick Draw (2m3f-3m hurdle/chase) and Guy (2m-2m4f hurdle/chase); dam, French 1m7f Listed hurdle winner, is a half-sister to French 2m2f hurdle winner, out of half-sister to French 3m3f Grade 1 chase winner; the market can guide for this debutante.

runners_data.name: Show Your Hand
runners_data.comment: Some promise when 17th in Newbury bumper, prominent to 3f out; could take big step forward
runners_data.spotlight: 66-1, showed some promise despite coming in 17th of 20 in bumper at Newbury 27 days ago, prominent to 3f out; tongue tie added; this Passing Glance gelding could take a sizeable step forward with that run under his belt.

runners_data.name: Roxy Rocks
runners_data.comment: Remote fourth in Taunton bumper on her debut; she needs to take a big step forward
runners_data.spotlight: 25-1, remote fourth of six in Taunton bumper on her debut 24 days ago; this Jukebox Jury mare needs to take a big step forward.
